rules.name: Build or deployment failure
rules.condition: A build, test, deployment, release, production service, certificate, domain, or integration failed or is blocked and requires intervention.

rules.name: Dev security or access change
rules.condition: A security, authentication, permission, key, token, vulnerability, or account-access change affects a development project or service I own.

rules.name: Review or reply requested
rules.condition: A person directly asks me to review code, make a technical decision, provide information, or reply about a development project.

rules.name: Store or policy action
rules.condition: An app store, developer platform, or service provider requires action to avoid rejection, suspension, expiration, policy non-compliance, or service interruption.

rules.name: User issue needs attention
rules.condition: A real user or tester reports a bug, failed purchase, refund problem, account problem, or other product issue that deserves a response.

rules.name: Deliveries and reservations
rules.condition: A parcel or order needs the recipient to act: it is waiting for pickup (locker, easybox, office) or about to be returned, a delivery failed or needs an address, phone confirmation or fee, or a booking, ticket or reservation was cancelled, changed, or needs confirmation. Order placed or confirmed, packed, shipped, handed to the courier, in transit, delivered, picked up and payment receipts do not count.

rules.name: School or family administration
rules.condition: The message contains an actionable school or family administration matter such as a form, permission or consent, required material, document, enrollment, deadline, or schedule change that the recipient should notice or act on.
